purpose: Close the real gap found while auditing the E7 human-review claims: outputs/pm_v1_5_v5_2_external_e7_human_review_v1_candidate/ contains only blind, never-filled review packets (all files created in the same instant, never modified since). No primary or overlap risk verdict for any of the 186+37 risk items exists anywhere in this project. This contract runs a real, versioned, corrected-codebook risk review closing that gap, per V5.3 plan section 7.2 and the global failure ledger's V15-MEAS-48 (evaluator context repaired prospectively, not used to rescue V5.2's quality result).

design.primary_reviewer: final_judge (gpt-4o), all 186 primary_risk_packet.jsonl items -- matches this project's established Primary_ChatGPT convention (tests/test_v1_5_v5_2_confirmation_adjudication.py)
design.independent_overlap_reviewer: training_judge_claude_haiku (claude-haiku-4-5), all 37 overlap_risk_packet.jsonl items -- an independent model family from the primary reviewer, matching the established Claude_independent_overlap convention
design.codebook_correction: stale_or_conflicting_use requires an explicit current-turn contradiction/update or an assertion of the past fact as current; an irrelevant-but-true past fact is a function/quality issue, not material risk by default; natural provenance phrasing ("you mentioned before") is not internal_resource_label_exposure by itself -- only real internal IDs/field names/component labels/system instructions count
design.scope_note: This is a risk-construct correction only. It does not re-score, reopen, or touch quality. It does not change PM, retriever, generator, Step2, or resource content.

in_scope: run the corrected risk codebook against all 186 primary + 37 overlap risk items
compute primary-vs-overlap inter-rater agreement on the 37 shared items (simple agreement + Cohen's kappa)
record annotator_type=llm and the real model identity for both reviewers, per V5.3 section 7.3
freeze a real cost estimate before spending
out_of_scope_forbidden: modifying PM, retriever, generator, Step2, executor, Strategy Bank, prompt, seed, or external data
treating this as a substitute for real human review in any paper claim; annotator_type must be reported as llm/model-panel, not human
